mode.title: Adaptive shadow mode
mode.description: Measure possible ladder changes without routing any request.

ladders.title: Provider ladders
ladders.description: Shadow-only ordered model steps for each Torana provider.

decision_model.title: Decision model
decision_model.description: Model identifier understood by the bound System One server, such as jev-latest, von-1.0.0, or a local Hugging Face model ID. Leading and trailing whitespace are rejected.

question.title: Routing question
question.description: The closed question the decision service answers from the latest user turn and bounded request facts.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Choice IDs and their approved Torana provider/model targets.

minimum_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
minimum_confidence.description: Keep the current route when the returned confidence is below this value.

max_state_bytes.title: Maximum user-turn bytes
max_state_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes from the latest textual user turn sent to the decision service.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Use none for local endpoints, or bearer with the separately bound api-key credential.

sticky.title: Keep route for conversation
sticky.description: Reuse the decision across turns and restarts. Disable only when deliberate per-request rerouting is worth changing model/provider and prompt-cache identity.
